intro: Finished in a sophisticated combination of soft cream and Valigny Oak, the Ergonest Dresser integrates thoughtful storage and everyday convenience into a design that complements contemporary bedrooms.

features.title: Full-length mirror for effortless grooming
features.text: The generously sized mirror provides a complete view for dressing and grooming, making everyday routines more comfortable while enhancing the sense of space within the room.

features.title: Hidden storage for organised essentials
features.text: Behind the mirror lies a thoughtfully planned storage area with multiple shelves, providing a discreet place for cosmetics, toiletries, jewellery, and everyday personal belongings.

features.title: Integrated bangle holders for accessory organisation
features.text: Dedicated bangle holders keep jewellery neatly arranged and easily accessible, helping maintain an organised dressing space.

features.title: Built-in power outlet for styling convenience
features.text: An integrated socket and switch allow effortless use of hair dryers and other grooming appliances, creating a practical personal grooming station.

features.title: Soft-close drawers for premium functionality
features.text: Equipped with soft-closing slides, the drawers glide smoothly and quietly while preventing abrupt closure, delivering a refined everyday experience.

features.title: Premium construction for lasting durability
features.text: Crafted using high-quality PU-painted MDF and pre-laminated boards with matching edge banding, Ergonest is engineered for dependable strength, durability, and a refined finish.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
